text:
morgan: Heads-up from onboarding run: node sampleapp showing intermittent email leak when auth retry happens. Looks like two different req_ids for same flow and one emit contains raw email. Repro below.

tia: can you paste the sanitized log lines + sdk init?

morgan: minimal excerpt: 
```
INFO 2026-11-01T09:12:01Z req_id=r-900 event=auth.start user=jamie@example.com
INFO 2026-11-01T09:12:02Z req_id=r-900 event=auth.retry attempt=1
ERROR 2026-11-01T09:12:03Z req_id=r-901 event=auth.finish user=jamie@example.com
```
first lines redacted, final leaked email and has new req_id. sample init: 
```js
Telemetry.init({ hooks: [otelAttach, redactOnAttach, sampler] })
```
app uses express + retry-mw that re-dispatches handler. Suspect attach-time redaction missed the re-emitted record.

ben: is this Node-only? any python/mobile repro?

morgan: quick smoke shows node only; mobile shims already run redaction on emit. Haven't repro'd python yet.

tia: two angles: (A) make redact run on final emit by default in node SDK, (B) preserve original x-request-id when retry re-dispatches. Also consider idempotent redaction so double-emits are cheap.

sdk-eng: quick idea: emit-time redact plus a tiny __redacted flag on the record. That covers replay without big perf hit. We'll also add an opt-in legacy mode to keep attach behavior for customers relying on that ordering.

ben: please add an integration test that simulates express retry re-dispatch and asserts stable req_id or preserved header and no raw emails. CI should fail if an email regex appears in integration logs.

ci-bot: opened ticket DE-8009: "node SDK: attach-vs-emit redaction inconsistency causing PII leak on retry" -> https://jira/redwood/DE-8009

morgan: local quickfix in sampleapp that worked: 
```js
logger.on('record', rec => { if (!rec.__redacted) { redact(rec); rec.__redacted = true } });
```
perf seemed fine on small runs but we need benchmarks.

sdk-eng: i'll draft PR to default to emit-stage redaction with a fastpath looksLikePII(rec) check and __redacted marker. Will include microbench and migration note. Also add a helper middleware to preserve x-request-id across replays.

tia: thanks. assign owners for DE-8009: sdk-eng for PR, ben for tests, morgan for repro artifacts. Then ship 0.12.4-canary and monitor PII dashboards.

morgan: thank you 44d. I'll attach the repro harness and sampleapp patch to the ticket.
